text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Dirt racing powerhouses gather for the 
highly anticipated JBC Classic. Transcend 
no longer harbors the doubts she once had.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She said that her feelings for this 
cherished place—feelings that once felt 
vague—now felt as deep and meaningful as 
Furioso's own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With unyielding feelings in her heart, 
Transcend stepped up to challenge the 
rematch.
